X179

  • n_TOF↔DREAM matching failures: root cause found, data recoverable 2026-08-12NTOFDAQAnalysisCampaignMatching

    25.7% of beam had no n_TOF match. Two bugs, both ours: pulse_match ties between supercycle-shifted locks, and bunch_join's offset bootstrap medians over bursts that have no pulse. Both destroy data rather than corrupting it; recovery demonstrated at 95.5%.

  • The chambers were bigger than we thought 2026-08-11NTOFMicromegasSimulationGeant4

    The MX17 active area in the Geant sim was an unsourced 38 x 34 cm guess. Beam data says 39.9 x 36.0 cm, and the 4 cm goes missing on the beam axis.

  • Overnight brief 2026-08-09 to 08-10 - the ion term IS the rise discrepancy 2026-08-10SimulationMicromegasWaveformsResponse model

    Rise gap measured distribution-wide at two inclinations (f_eff 0-0.25 vs defended 0.9056); amplitude ledger closes to a single candidate (avalanche gain, x1.6 demanded, x1.44 slope error); ion contradiction cornered structurally by a sheet-screening re-derivation; X/Y asymmetry is 18%, not a factor; wet gain bracket 4/4 predictions confirmed and it deepens the amplitude deficit to x2.16.

  • DREAM ↔ n_TOF clock QA 2026-08-09NTOFDAQAnalysisCampaignTiming

    Per-segment QA for the DREAM to n_TOF clock fit: 116 slimmed segments, ringing-aware checks (largest-pulse plastic primary, shadow-flag late tail), sided containment, and the fixed per-arm offset estimator — 112 pass, 4 warn, 0 fail, 0 outliers.

  • How much charge does the gamma flash deliver? Two independent measurements 2026-08-09NTOFMicromegasGamma flashDAQ

    The flash puts ~1000x the DREAM front end full-scale charge onto a single micromegas strip, measured on a 1 GS/s readout with no preamplifier and cross-checked against the HV supply current; with the real board accounting (checkerboard pad combs, 85 % image capture, exact 50/50 X/Y) the two absolute scales agree once the flash is ~4x denser at this strip than the chamber average -- which the strip's own intensity compression independently confirms. Gain cannot fix it and the millisecond dead time follows from it.

  • T14 - MX17 response simulation vs det3 data at the waveform level 2026-08-09SimulationMicromegasWaveformsResponse model

    First pre-registered sim/data comparison (W2 rho2M + dry 95/5 + 490 V): same ballpark, not agreement - sim x0.53-0.64 low in amplitude, shapes close; bump artifact and overshoot systematics measured.

  • A general-purpose coding agent as the control layer of a bespoke beam experiment 2026-08-08NTOFDAQAgentsPaper

    Draft summary and evidence for a paper on using a general-purpose coding agent as the control and analysis layer of the MX17 experiment during the summer 2026 n_TOF beam run.

  • n_TOF processing — the 41 X17 runs still needed 2026-08-08NTOFProcessingHandoff

    The 5-7 August pass used our UserInput exactly, verified parameter for parameter, then stopped. 325 runs are done; 41 remain, block 117 h of X17 beam time, and have no processed output of any kind.

  • X17 at nTOF — where the six weeks went 2026-08-07NTOFDAQAnalysisCampaign

    Estimated time, DAQ vs analysis effort, and a per-day log of what was worked on across the 41-day X17 beam campaign, reconstructed from 195,409 events on four machines.
